'''Daro root''' was a type of root that grew on several [[Human/Legends|Human]]-colonized [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It contained sweet, creamy [[Color/Legends|golden]] flesh.<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
